values.note: Reserve by phone (704-463-5797); the first night is paid in advance and deposits are non-refundable. Race week (Charlotte Motor Speedway) and holidays need 2 nights, paid in full. 'RV's, camping and cabin rentals open 7 days a week but call first.' Long-term lots by phone.

note: Gold-mining-themed campground near New London (recreational prospecting closed since 2016; mining seminars still offered); prospector cabins and dry-camping sites as well. --Claude
summary: Operator page confirms year-round operation, phone booking, full hookups 30A (50A +$3), showers/laundry/WiFi/store, 2-night race-week/holiday minimum; its rate table ($25 FHU, $17 dry) is undated, so fees were left as recorded. Gate n/a.
flags: Website appears compromised or SEO-injected: the camping page carries long paragraphs promoting UK van insurance ('Tesco van insurance', 'Van Insurance Britain', '£1500 to £2000'), including the only statement that the campground 'supports vehicles up to 50 feet' (the basis of the derived sites.max_rig_ft 50, which should not be trusted).

Fees: the rate table ($25 full hookup 30A, +$3 for 50A, dry camping $17, monthly $350) carries no year; the only date is the server's Last-Modified 2026-07-22. Fees left as recorded (2026-10-16 read) for lack of a dated rate.
